games.name: [NEW 🗺️] Trident Survival
games.desc:
Gather resources, craft, loot, steal, build, and survive. Trident Survival brings a unique movement-based PvPvE survival experience. Farm for building materials and gather weapons to build and defend your base. Loot structures around the island - battling NPCs and other players that stand in your way. Build your arsenal of armor, guns, and explosives. Become the raider - or be raided.

Your location, items, and buildings will be saved on a per-server basis automatically.
Servers reset and remove all buildings every Friday @ 2PM EST.
Use of exploits is not tolerated. Exceeding max clan member limit will result in a ban.

Available Platforms:
- PC
- XBOX
- MOBILE (BETA)

Key binds can be found and changed in settings tab.
